columns.name: episode_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the episode

columns.name: episode
columns.description: the sequential number of the episode within a specific season

columns.name: number_of_keywords
columns.description: The number of keywords in the episode, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_crews_in_art
columns.description: the number of crews in the Art Department that the episode has, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_nominations
columns.description: the number of nominations that the episode has, replace NULL values with 0. Nominations include both nominations and winners.

columns.name: ratio_of_American_casts
columns.description: The percentage of casts in the episode who was born in America.

columns.name: number_of_1_star_votes
columns.description: the number of 1-star votes that the episode has, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the person

columns.name: birth_country
columns.description: The country where the person was born

columns.name: organization_most_awards
columns.description: the organization in which the person win the most awards, with ties broken by the ascending order of the organization

columns.name: percentage_of_episodes_appeared_in_series
columns.description: The percentage of episodes in which a person appeared, relative to the total number of episodes in the series.

columns.name: has_won_at_least_3_awards
columns.description: set to 1 if the person has won at least 3 awards, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: number_of_times_credited
columns.description: the number of times that the person shows up in the on-screen credits, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: average_star_rating
columns.description: The average star rating of the episodes the person has worked on, calculated as a weighted average using data from the Vote table.
